psp.show_message.description: Show a short text message on the screen of the user's Sony PSP and speak it aloud through the PSP's speaker. Keep it under about 200 characters.

text.description: The message to show and speak.

title.description: A short heading above the message.

psp.clear.description: Clear the message on the PSP and go back to the avatar.

psp.dance.description: Make the Muse avatar on the user's PSP dance. The avatar is you, so call this when the user says 'make Muse dance', 'dance', or asks you or their PSP to dance.

psp.status.description: Read the user's Sony PSP's battery level, whether it is charging or plugged in, minutes of battery left, and Wi-Fi network and signal strength. Call this when the user asks about their PSP's battery, power or connection.
